stage0053_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ラム$$
「The Federation and Neo Zeon...
　seems it's fierce fighting in some areas」

stage0053_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$キャシー$$
「And humanity shouldn't be fighting itself...」

stage0053_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ボビー$$
「It's fine, $$キャシー$$.
　Boss understands that much, too」

stage0053_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This is Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$, of $c,
　an independent Earth Federation unit」

stage0053_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We're acting under special orders right now,
　unrelated to the war against Neo Zeon.
　We have no intention of engaging you」

stage0053_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$レズン$$
「Don't make me laugh!
　What reason would there be to let a special
　unit go, mid-battle!」

stage0053_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「No choice...
　we'll have to fight back」

stage0053_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Understood!
　All units, launch immediately!」

stage0053_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n... don't we need to sortie?」

stage0053_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$n
「Our orders are to stand by.
　We'll go out if the situation calls for it」

stage0053_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$n
（Considering Miss $$スズネ$$'s stress, Captain
　$$オズマ$$ ordered us to stand by. I hope this
　eases her burden, even a little...）

stage0053_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Does Neo Zeon not understand
　what the situation is right now...!」

stage0053_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Probably because the truth about
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$ hasn't gone public yet」

stage0053_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$リディ$$
「Even so,
　we can't just let ourselves be beaten!」

stage0053_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right.
　All units, think about breaking through
　here as fast as possible」

stage0053_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$エマ$$
「Federation forces are closing on this area!」

stage0053_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$桂$$
「Nice reinforcements!
　...not that this is time to celebrate」

stage0053_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$オズマ$$
「This will only spread the fighting further」

stage0053_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Lieutenant $$キャシー$$,
　leave this to us, and tell them
　to fall back」

stage0053_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ラム$$
「I intercepted a transmission, and
　something's wrong with the Federation pilots!」

stage0053_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The exact opposite intent...!
　Are they under $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$'s control!」

stage0053_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$カトル$$
「No way...!
　What are we supposed to do...!?」

stage0053_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「We have no choice but to fight...」

stage0053_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$レズン$$
「Infighting, is it?
　So much for the Federation's caliber!」

stage0053_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$レズン$$
「Sorry, but I'll take advantage of that!」

stage0053_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$シモン$$
「Everyone, be careful!
　Geminis might be nearby!」

stage0053_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$カレン$$
「Those guys...!
　Are they watching us Earthlings fight
　each other for fun, from somewhere!」

stage0053_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$カツ$$
「Geminis might be nearby, and we're
　fighting a battle like this...!」

stage0053_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$カレン$$
「Even so, we have to do it!」

stage0053_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$カレン$$
「You, at a time like this!」

stage0053_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Don't rush.
　A reliable ally has arrived」

stage0053_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$アルト$$
「Even he can't do it alone...!」

stage0053_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Well done, $$スザク$$!
　Leave the rest to me!」

stage0053_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$赤木$$
「And he missed every cockpit, too!」

stage0053_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Once the enemy's lured into position,
　a calculation like this is child's play」

stage0053_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I am $$ゼロ$$...!
　The man who will bring victory to this world!」

stage0053_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$レズン$$
「So that's $$ゼロ$$ of the Black Knights!
　Whatever the reason he showed up,
　if he waltzed in, I'll just crush him...!」

stage0053_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I know.
　I'll deal with the rest of them too」

stage0053_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Did you think I would come here
　without any preparation?」

stage0053_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「People of Neo Zeon...
　don't tell me you don't know my name」

stage0053_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll say it again.
　My name is $$ゼロ$$...!
　The man who will bring victory to this world!」

stage0053_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$レズン$$
（What now, is he bluffing...?
　But if it's true, this could turn into
　an irreversible mess...）

stage0053_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Now, people of the Federation...
　with Neo Zeon withdrawn, your duty is done.
　Fall back」

stage0053_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「To the Federation, $$ゼロ$$, supreme commander
　of the Black Knights, is a deeply suspicious figure」

stage0053_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I see...
　so that reversal made you trust $$ゼロ$$?」

stage0053_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Amazing...
　he stopped the fight with words alone」

stage0053_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What's going on!
　What kind of trick is this!」

stage0053_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's neither magic nor a trick.
　This is closer to a negotiation technique」

stage0053_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「His own name value, and the overwhelming
　power he flaunted when he arrived...」

stage0053_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Using those two things, $$ゼロ$$ made the
　downside of fighting him clear」

stage0053_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「For Neo Zeon too, this fight with us
　was more of a chance encounter.
　No more reinforcements will come」

stage0053_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「As skillful as ever, $$ゼロ$$.
　My thanks」

stage0053_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$, the battle isn't over yet」

stage0053_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「So we were noticed」

stage0053_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I haven't been chasing you for nothing」

stage0053_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$スザク$$
「You, who caused the war between Earth
　and the colonies, end here!」

stage0053_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$カレン$$
「So $$ゼロ$$ and $$スザク$$ were after Geminis too...!」

stage0053_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's right.
　We've been working with Celestial Being
　to investigate the incident that started the war」

stage0053_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「But aiming your anger at us is misplaced.
　We did spark the fighting, true, but it's
　you Earthlings who are actually fighting」

stage0053_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「All we did was hasten your ruin
　by just a little」

stage0053_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$n
「You... how can you say that
　in front of everyone who died!」

stage0053_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Such a knowing tone, for a child.
　This is our duty」

stage0053_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$アルト$$
「Says the one profiting off others' fights!」

stage0053_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$甲児$$
「I don't know why you're after Earth,
　but using dirty tricks just because
　you're not strong enough yourselves!」

stage0053_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$n
「Sorry, Miss $$スズネ$$...
　I really didn't want you to have to fight...」

stage0053_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$n
「But! Her, or rather them, are the
　ones I absolutely can't forgive!」

stage0053_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Go ahead and try it, if you can.
　Don't think barking alone will win!」

stage0053_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Leave it, $n.
　Logic won't reach a woman like that」

stage0053_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Drive the shame of defeat deep into her bones」

stage0053_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Can the likes of you actually do that?」

stage0053_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$n
「Lives stolen away by someone else's
　selfish logic...! I've had enough of that!!」

stage0053_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Can you hear me, $n!
　That readout means the $$ジェニオン$$'s power gauge
　has broken past its expected limiter!」

stage0053_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As I thought, the $$ジェニオン$$ has a function
　that raises output based on the pilot's mental state!」

stage0053_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$キラ$$
「Isn't that the same as a $$スフィア$$-equipped unit...!」

stage0053_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then the $$ジェニオン$$ too...!」

stage0053_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It seems the $$ジェニオン$$'s limiter has
　now been fully released!
　This means $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ can activate!」

stage0053_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've sent the activation keyword!
　The $$ＤＥＭ$$ regulator I prepared should
　work too, even unfinished!」

stage0053_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$n
「$$ジェニオン・ガイ$$!
　Full $$ブーストアップ$$!!」

stage0053_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$n
「With this power, I can do it!」

stage0053_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Be careful, $n!
　As it stands, GAI Mode only lasts one minute!」

stage0053_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$スズネ$$
「So in other words, the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$
　reverts to the $$ジェニオン$$ in one minute」

stage0053_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$n
「Then I'll beat him in that one minute!」

stage0053_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Don't get cocky with me...!
　An imitation can't beat our $$ディオスク$$!」

stage0053_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin the attack!
　Concentrate fire on the enemy commander,
　with the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ leading the charge!」

stage0053_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ジェニオン・ガイ$$!
　We'll provide cover for you!
　Fight as you see fit!」

stage0053_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$n
「Here I come, $$アンナロッタ$$!
　I'll beat you with this $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$!!」

stage0053_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Tch!
　What is the meaning of this!?」

stage0053_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$n
「$$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$!
　I'll settle this here and now!」

stage0053_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I... can't afford to die here!」

stage0053_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$n
「Not yet!
　I'm beating him here, no matter what!」

stage0053_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hey now, kid.
　I held back when I hit you,
　so don't make such a fuss about it」

stage0053_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well... no wonder, being an imitation!」

stage0053_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$, is it!」

stage0053_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$葵$$
「It looks just like $n's $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$!」

stage0053_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't say such nasty things.
　That kid's machine is copying mine, actually」

stage0053_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Now then, allow me to show it off to you all」

stage0053_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「This is my partner... the pride
　of the Geminaids, $$ジェミニア$$」

stage0053_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「And while I'm at it, the one piloting it
　is the 'Feuding Twins' $$スフィア・リアクター$$」

stage0053_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So his machine has a $$スフィア$$ too...!」

stage0053_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$シモン$$
「'Feuding Twins'...
　So that's the name of his $$スフィア$$!」

stage0053_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$n
「$$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ is...
　a copy... of his machine...」

stage0053_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's not something so grand」

stage0053_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That treasure you hold so dear
　is nothing but a cheap imitation!」

stage0053_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Shocked?
　But then, I'd like you to consider how
　I and the rest of Geminis feel, getting copied」

stage0053_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「After all, this $$ジェミニア$$
　is the pride of planet Geminai」

stage0053_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it!
　We're going to help $n!」

stage0053_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Oh my... what caring friends.
　But I'll have to punish you two as well」

stage0053_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「After all, you underestimated Geminis' power」

stage0053_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「We never used our full strength,
　it was just a game of wiping out Earthlings」

stage0053_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Even head-on, there's no way we'd lose,
　not as long as this $$ジェミニア$$ is around」

stage0053_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「The power of a $$スフィア$$!」

stage0053_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Now, now, $$アンナロッタ$$ dear.
　Leave this to me and head on back」

stage0053_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...Can't you follow my orders, $$アンナロッタ$$?」

stage0053_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't give me such a hard time, honey.
　You're a hope of the Geminaids too」

stage0053_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Now then... care to dance with me,
　$c, Earth Sphere's proud strongest?」

stage0053_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「And I'll have you learn the meaning
　of the phrase 'a frog in a well'」

stage0053_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't get cocky!
　Don't think you can turn this around alone!」

stage0053_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'll play along, just for one minute.
　Regret underestimating Geminis while it lasts」

stage0053_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「If we disable and capture him in this minute,
　we might avoid the $$エタニティ・フラット$$!」

stage0053_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin the attack!
　Don't let $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ escape!」

stage0053_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well then, let's begin.
　One minute that'll feel like an eternity to you」

stage0053_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well done, well done.
　Seems I was the one underestimating you」

stage0053_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But you're still not there yet」

stage0053_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「His skill with a $$スフィア$$
　rivals 《$$ユーサー$$》 $$インサラウム$$'s!?」

stage0053_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$n
「Are we... unable to beat him...
　after all...」

stage0053_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hm...?
　This might be bad...」

stage0053_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$タケル$$
「Strong...!
　It's strength on a whole different level!」

stage0053_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「His skill with a $$スフィア$$
　rivals 《$$ユーサー$$》 $$インサラウム$$'s!?」

stage0053_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hey now... only just noticing now?」

stage0053_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$n
「Are we... unable to beat him...
　after all...」

stage0053_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hm...?
　This might be bad...」

stage0053_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Dimensional boundary distortion confirmed!
　A $$時空震動$$ is about to occur!」

stage0053_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$赤木$$
「Doesn't seem to be an $$インベーダー#keyword$$...!」

stage0053_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's... the embodiment of endless destruction...」

stage0053_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
($$ルルーシュ$$... in the 《$$黄昏の間$$》,
　did you touch the 《$$アーカーシャの剣$$》...)

stage0053_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$竜馬$$
「My gut's telling me!
　These guys are different from any foe so far!」

stage0053_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's right.
　This truly is a calamity descending」

stage0053_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$!
　What is that!?」

stage0053_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I've no obligation to answer that.
　Their arrival's unexpected for me too, after all」

stage0053_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「For now, I'll tell you just this much」

stage0053_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Their name is Space Monster.
　The so-called $$バアル$$」

stage0053_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$バアル$$... mankind's natural enemy...」

stage0053_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$シモン$$
「Was it to show us these things
　that $$アドヴェント$$ brought us up to space!?」

stage0053_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$刹那$$
「Communication is impossible!
　We have no choice but to intercept!」

stage0053_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Begin the attack!
　Don't forget the Earth is behind us!!」

stage0053_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「These things...!
　They charge in without any fear at all!」

stage0053_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So they're literally embodiments of destruction!」

stage0053_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$アルト$$
「This is bad...!
　Not with our strength worn down from Geminis...!」

stage0053_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$宗介$$
「Stop it, $n!
　This is not a foe recklessness can beat!」

stage0053_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$n
「Even so, I can at least buy some time!」

stage0053_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$甲児$$
「You idiot!
　Don't go throwing your life away like that!」

stage0053_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ミーナ#120$$
「Captain!
　The hangar hatch has been opened!」

stage0053_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$キャシー$$
「No way...!
　We never gave a launch order!」

stage0053_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The robot that was frozen in that ice...!」

stage0053_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ボビー$$
「That girl...!
　What does she think she's doing!?」

stage0053_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Don't tell me... she means to fight that $$バアル$$...」

stage0053_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Come back!
　What can you do, having just woken up!?」

stage0053_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「But right now!
　I need to fight, I have no choice!」

stage0053_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$...
　And this robot is the $$ガンバスター$$!」

stage0053_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「The power to protect Earth... everyone's hope!」

stage0053_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「You, provide backup for the $$ガンバスター$$!」

stage0053_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Sorry, $$ガンバスター$$.
　Big Sis isn't here, and you're worn out too, but...」

stage0053_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「To protect that star, Earth, from the Space Monsters!!」

stage0053_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, support that robot... the $$ガンバスター$$!」

stage0053_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That strong will...!
　She shares the same resolve as us!」

stage0053_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$ノリコ$$, was it!
　We're right behind you!」

stage0053_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$!
　Let's go!!」

stage0053_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Enemy forces confirmed wiped out.
　No reinforcements in sight either.」

stage0053_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$キャシー$$
(Why is the Federation here...)

stage0053_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ラム$$
(Isn't it because they sensed the Space Monsters?)

stage0053_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ミーナ#120$$
(Even if they sent a fleet from there,
　there's no way it'd arrive on time.)

stage0053_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$サイガス$$
「I have a message for $c.
　This is Brigadier General $$サイガス・エイロニー$$
　of EFF Supreme Command.」

stage0053_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ボビー$$
(There it is...!
　The EFF's gunship!)

stage0053_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This is Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$,
　of $c.
　Now, what might your business be?」

stage0053_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$サイガス$$
「We already know of this hostile alien species.
　And in exchange for that data...」

stage0053_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$サイガス$$
「You will hand over the giant mobile weapon
　and the pilot you have in custody.」

stage0053_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Do they mean Miss $$ノリコ$$'s $$ガンバスター$$...?」

stage0053_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$サイガス$$
「That will make for a great asset.
　Supreme Command will take charge of it.」

stage0053_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Disregarding her own wishes, are we?」

stage0053_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$サイガス$$
「She's a lone transferee.
　That can be handled however we like.」

stage0053_04:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...As for data on these Space Monsters,
　we will submit it to Supreme Command
　later, through Commander $$レディ・アン$$.」

stage0053_04:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But regarding Miss $$ノリコ$$ Takaya and
　the $$ガンバスター$$, we must refuse.」

stage0053_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Because she is a human being, nothing more.」

stage0053_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Her actions from here on should be
　decided by her own will.」

stage0053_04:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Sophistry...!
　Is that how $c means to
　keep building up its forces!?」

stage0053_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I'll say it once more.
　What we took in was not a weapon.
　It was a human being.」

stage0053_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「...Captain $$ジェフリー$$,
　could you explain this world's situation to me?」

stage0053_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$サイガス$$
「That is our job to do!」

stage0053_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I can't trust anyone who talks about
　'capture' and 'handover' like that.」

stage0053_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「And of course, I won't let people like that
　do as they please with this $$ガンバスター$$.」

stage0053_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The situation speaks for itself.
　Please leave, Brigadier General $$サイガス$$.」

stage0053_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$サイガス$$
「...You will regret this one day.
　No, I'll make sure of it!」

stage0053_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Supreme Command, and $$サイガス・エイロニー$$...」

stage0053_04:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Why in the world do they want Miss $$ノリコ$$...?」

stage0053_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ボビー$$
「Seems they want to turn visitors from other
　worlds into troops for their own war.」

stage0053_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
(But that Federation fleet's arrival timing...
　could they have known Space Monsters were coming...)

stage0053_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$スズネ$$
「We have to fight things like that too...」

stage0053_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「To think Space Monsters were still alive...」

stage0053_04:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$n
「You and your robot were fighting that...?」

stage0053_04:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yeah...
　Maybe long before your time, even.」

stage0053_04:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「But I knew right away...
　that you're the same as us,
　a power meant to protect Earth...」

stage0053_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ノリコ$$
(I'm home, Earth...
　$$ガンバスター$$ and I are back...)

stage0053_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Neo Zeon and Federation forces confirmed retreating.」

stage0053_04:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Geminis might still come.
　We'll stay on alert as is.」

stage0053_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$レズン$$
「Tch!
　Guess this foe wasn't worth half measures!」

stage0053_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So, you're the grade-school president, huh.
　Working hard, for someone so small.」

stage0053_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't treat me like a kid!
　When I'm riding my Trider,
　I'm one of $c protecting Earth!」

stage0053_04:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「My apologies.
　This old man's jobless, so someone as
　promising as you makes him jealous.」

stage0053_04:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Now I'm mad!
　Guys like you need a good lesson!」

stage0053_04:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Now that's something to look forward to!
　This old man's starved for excitement!」

stage0053_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Show me, Mars.
　That psychic power you're so proud of.」

stage0053_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I've been curious, you see.
　About the power that beat an heir of 《$$黒の英知$$》.」

stage0053_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's the one.
　Now, show me that power of love.」

stage0053_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'll teach you that things like that mean
　nothing before overwhelming power!」

stage0053_04:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Now that's a fancy toy.
　Not something a kid should be playing with.」

stage0053_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Now, now... don't get so mad.
　If I've upset you, this old man's sorry too.」

stage0053_04:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Yours isn't the only toy robot, though.
　Next to my $$ジェミニア$$,
　everyone's just toys or mud dolls.」

stage0053_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't mess with me!
　There's no way $$鉄人２８号#robot$$ loses
　to someone fighting half-heartedly!」

stage0053_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Now that's a surprise!
　Could you be... an $$異能生存体$$!?」

stage0053_04:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Then you get it too, right?
　That you shouldn't fight me.」

stage0053_04:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no time for your idle chatter.」

stage0053_04:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Is that so?
　But when I finish talking,
　that's when your immortal legend ends too.」

stage0053_04:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Nice to meet you, original Singularity.
　I'm glad to finally meet you.」

stage0053_04:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$桂$$
「Same here.
　I need to beat you down and get
　the Prison of Time destroyed, fast.」

stage0053_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't say that.
　This thing's quite a piece of work.」

stage0053_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Though it seems we pushed things quite far
　just to draw in a special guy like you.」

stage0053_04:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$桂$$
「Talking like it's someone else's problem!
　Guess we're just not gonna get along!」

stage0053_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Oh, this is bad...
　The power I sealed away is stirring again.」

stage0053_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you talking about Newtypes!?」

stage0053_04:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Correct.
　Things get messy once those wake up.」

stage0053_04:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Can't tell you that one.
　But if anyone understands it best,
　it's us, Geminis.」

stage0053_04:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So, before your power fully awakens,
　I'll just go ahead and finish you off!」

stage0053_04:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「$$アムロ・レイ$$...!
　To play it safe, I'll finish you here!」

stage0053_04:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「The pressure's changed!
　Bringing your killing intent to the front!」

stage0053_04:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Those sharp senses... that's the danger.
　You're a headache in more ways than one.」

stage0053_04:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Sorry, but against you,
　I'll have to get a bit serious!」

stage0053_04:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「This man... it's not just his $$スフィア$$ or machine...!
　He's top-class as a pilot too!」

stage0053_04:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Scary.
　Your glare feels like it's piercing the cockpit.」

stage0053_04:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Idle words are unnecessary.
　$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$... I will eliminate you.」

stage0053_04:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Good grief...
　Looking down on me like that... guess you
　still don't get your own position.」

stage0053_04:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's you Earthlings who are
　the ones getting erased from this universe.」

stage0053_04:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Your feats in Orb surprised me.
　Never thought rage would break the seal.」

stage0053_04:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「SEED...
　I got to see that power of yours.」

stage0053_04:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$シン$$
「...Is that all you have to say?」

stage0053_04:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$シン$$
「I haven't forgotten
　that you tried to burn Orb to the ground!」

stage0053_04:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$シン$$
「I will never forgive those who start wars
　and try to spread them further!!」

stage0053_04:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Heh... you've got SEED too, huh.」

stage0053_04:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Ah... no need to worry about it.
　You're finished here either way.」

stage0053_04:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$キラ$$
「Just what is it you're after,
　throwing this world into chaos!?」

stage0053_04:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Huh, did I not say?
　It's just to kill time.」

stage0053_04:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$キラ$$
「I can't accept an answer like that!」

stage0053_04:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's just how the world often works.
　So, from here on, I'll have you taste
　the most senseless unfairness there is.」

stage0053_04:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Violence with no particular reason to it!」

stage0053_04:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Being stared down by those golden eyes
　is more than I can take. Can you see the future?」

stage0053_04:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$刹那$$
「This man... he knows about Innovators!?」

stage0053_04:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Sure I do.
　But we went to all the trouble of sealing it,
　and you had to go and break it...」

stage0053_04:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$刹那$$
「Why did you try to seal away the Innovators!?」

stage0053_04:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That was for your own good.
　Just an elder's meddling, you could say.」

stage0053_04:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$刹那$$
「Don't mock me!
　Don't think you can toy with the world any longer!」

stage0053_04:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I can, though.
　As long as this $$ジェミニア$$ exists.」

stage0053_04:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Honestly...!
　One awakened soul after another shows up!
　This planet really is dangerous!」

stage0053_04:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What are you talking about!?」

stage0053_04:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So naive.
　Seems you haven't yet noticed
　your own power, your own possibilities.」

stage0053_04:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But I'll have you disappear.
　The world has no need for a beast of possibility.」

stage0053_04:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't let you!
　I haven't even done anything yet!」

stage0053_04:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's exactly why.
　A bad seed's best nipped while it's still small.」

stage0053_04:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「The blood of beasts awakening this fast...
　now that's something I didn't expect.」

stage0053_04:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$葵$$
「Talking about a person's body like that...
　you really are a tactless man.」

stage0053_04:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「My apologies.
　Seems I forgot my manners toward a lady.」

stage0053_04:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$葵$$
「While you're apologizing, why don't you
　tell us your entire plan right here!」

stage0053_04:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'll have to pass on that.
　I'm rather fond of this game, you see.」

stage0053_04:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$葵$$
「Keep playing around with us half-heartedly
　and you'll get more than burned!」

stage0053_04:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Nice, that beat you're laying down!
　It's hitting me and $$ジェミニア$$ right in the heart!」

stage0053_04:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Right!?
　Cut the crap with this war,
　and listen to my song!」

stage0053_04:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「War's a load of crap, huh...
　You're absolutely right about that.」

stage0053_04:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well... doing that load of crap
　is all I can do right now, though.」

stage0053_04:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$アルト$$
「This guy's strength...!
　It's on a whole other level!」

stage0053_04:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well... believe it or not, I'm paying
　a fair price for it myself.」

stage0053_04:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well... I carry more than some kid
　content just flying around the sky.」

stage0053_04:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$アルト$$
「This guy... how far does he need to push me!?」

stage0053_04:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So young.
　Flare up at an enemy's taunt like that
　and you won't live long, kid!」

stage0053_04:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If you're that confident in your power,
　then I'll put it to the test!」

stage0053_04:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hey now... don't go calling me
　some insufferable, stuck-up jerk.
　I know my own powerlessness, believe it or not.」

stage0053_04:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Even so, I'm still stronger
　than all of you combined.」

stage0053_04:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$エタニティ・フラット$$'s business can wait!
　First, me and Getter are gonna
　knock that smug attitude right out of you!」

stage0053_04:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「For the successor to the God of Light,
　you're awfully pathetic.」

stage0053_04:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「And on top of that, the boy piloting it
　sounds passionate if you're kind about it,
　but he's one step from being a simpleton.」

stage0053_04:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$甲児$$
「You think I'll fall for a taunt like that!?」

stage0053_04:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You already looked plenty fired up to me?」

stage0053_04:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$甲児$$
「This anger's been in me from the start!
　Aimed at you, for wrecking our world!」

stage0053_04:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$甲児$$
「And I'll show you!
　The power of me and Mazinger, the one you mocked!」

stage0053_04:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Too bad.
　The world's not so soft that saying
　a cool catchphrase is enough to win.」

stage0053_04:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$赤木$$
「Geminis!
　I will never forgive what you've done!」

stage0053_04:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$赤木$$
「I'll stop you right here
　and save the world!」

stage0053_04:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Can a mere salaryman really pull that off?」

stage0053_04:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$赤木$$
「I'll prove it!
　Even a salaryman can protect the peace!」

stage0053_04:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「There it is, the catchphrase.
　But you're going to lose anyway.」

stage0053_04:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「To me, an unemployed good-for-nothing.」

stage0053_04:r_7d9f085a5d9c51fd.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「You took care of me back in Paradigm City.」

stage0053_04:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Tell me about it.
　No idea how much I spent on your bar tabs.」

stage0053_04:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「For that, you have my thanks.」

stage0053_04:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Why, thank you.
　As expected of Mister Negotiator...
　you know your manners.」

stage0053_04:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「This settles the score between us.
　Now I'll go all out.」

stage0053_04:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「OK.
　Killing a drinking buddy was giving me
　a bit of a guilty conscience, so that helps.」

stage0053_04:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's a good one,
　$$ルルーシュ$$ vi Britannia.
　Putting on a mask, and calling it atonement?」

stage0053_04:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「So you knew who I really am.」

stage0053_04:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You were digging into my background too,
　so we're even.」

stage0053_04:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then let me tell you, $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$...
　I don't fight only for atonement, for my own past!」

stage0053_04:r_69bf15620a355d50.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's to protect the future of this world
　where the people precious to me live!」

stage0053_04:r_ae4d9169d6ff43a4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「How admirable of you!
　Even though you half-know what awaits that future!」

stage0053_04:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「How about it?
　Piloting that Aquarion of yours,
　doesn't it give you strange feelings?」

stage0053_04:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Like I'd listen to a word you say!
　Thanks to you, our world
　got tossed over here in the first place!」

stage0053_04:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well... fine.
　Can't blame you for thinking that.」

stage0053_04:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But I'll crush you here,
　before the meeting of waters awakens!」

stage0053_04:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Tough luck for you too.
　Made to pilot that thing, saddled
　with such a grand destiny.」

stage0053_04:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$シンジ$$
「This man... he knows about EVA?」

stage0053_04:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「At least more than you do.
　So let me enlighten you.」

stage0053_04:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If you don't want to be unhappy,
　you'd best get off that thing quick.」

stage0053_04:r_28066ae0934e6411.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I've... piloted EVA through
　a lot of scary things, awful things,
　but I found good things too...!」

stage0053_04:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So I'll fight...!
　I'll do what I can, together with everyone!」

stage0053_04:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「No good...
　A boy who won't listen to his elders
　needs to be punished.」

stage0053_04:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Wherever the wind blows, wherever the mood takes...
　which way's your drill pointed, kid?」

stage0053_04:r_4a301748a7930689.text:
$$シモン$$
「Get ready, Geminis!
　I'm gonna drill through you, and while I'm at it,
　drill through the Prison of Time too!」

stage0053_04:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Things don't work out that conveniently.
　Not this fight, Earth's future, nor you and her.」

stage0053_04:r_5135fdea02c6bd7b.text:
$$宗介$$
「This man...!
　First-rate, both as a commander and as a soldier!」

stage0053_04:r_c545a5a303470d2c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Call it 'still got it,' even past my prime...
　well... at least this much, anyway.」

stage0053_04:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「In other words, for me,
　even hitting the front lines is just killing time.」

stage0053_04:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$宗介$$
「Correction.
　Belittle an enemy, you're a second-rate soldier!」

stage0053_04:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's how it should be.
　Even if I drop a rank or two,
　I'm still plenty stronger than you.」

stage0053_04:r_f2655371e3ef7b59.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「What's wrong, kid?
　Looks like you ran out of strength to hold your form!」

stage0053_04:r_ee7f46e6a631fd5c.text:
$n
「Even without becoming $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$...!」

stage0053_04:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I respect the spirit, but it's no use.
　With power beneath even an imitation,
　there's no way you can beat the original.」

stage0053_04:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Sheesh... to scold youthful recklessness,
　seems I've got to show overwhelming power.」

stage0053_04:r_1d13d9bb6a6d7818.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Reality is this harsh...
　learn it with your own body.」

stage0053_04:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$n
「I can do this...!
　With the power of this $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$,
　I can fight anyone!」

stage0053_04:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$n
「I don't need forgiveness from a coward...!
　I'll just defeat you and corner your captain!」

stage0053_04:r_c2a5e2a9019026a4.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Don't think the captain deals with the likes of you!
　Much less an imitation!」

stage0053_04:r_855e82ce06693ee8.text:
$$スザク$$
「The day's finally come, hasn't it.」

stage0053_04:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$$スザク$$
「Whatever form it takes is fine.
　Let's keep fighting for this world too.」

stage0053_04:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's right.
　That's the mission placed on both our lives.」

stage0053_04:r_6a5a0a8d6d6a68fd.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Let's go, $$スザク$$!
　With the two of us together, nothing's impossible!」

stage0053_04:r_fa54b106906131ec.text:
$$ノリコ$$
（Big Sis...
　This must be some far-off future
　where nobody remembers us anymore...）

stage0053_04:r_64f86b30363f1f4c.text:
$$ノリコ$$
（Separated from Big Sis, I'm now... all alone...）

stage0053_04:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$$ノリコ$$
（But what Coach and Big Sis taught me
　is still burning in my heart, even now...!）

stage0053_04:r_afa4e4bac1376010.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「So I'll fight!
　To protect the Earth with $$ガンバスター$$!!」
